'''Simlo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] along with fellow doctors [[Addy Ingrol]], [[Asirr]], [[Evad]], [[Tarkom]] and [[Proxinus]] she assisted Doctor [[Sannus Lorrick]], who was experimenting on the [[rakghoul]] virus in his [[Lost Island|laboratory]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Simlo and the scientists all believed that Lorrick was searching for a cure on the virus, but after four Tionese planets [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|fell]] to the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]], they discovered Lorrick's true plans to evolve the virus and attempted to stop him. They were infected with the virus and placed under his control, but were soon killed when a strike team [[Mission to the Lost Island|stormed]] the base and killed Lorrick.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Simlo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the flashpoint "Lost Island."
